sections.headline: Understand the Markets. Make Informed Decisions.
sections.copy: Share prices can rise and fall, and investors can lose part or all of the money invested. Equity services at Lotus Capital are offered as an Authorised Person of Religare Broking Limited. Speak with the team to confirm the service, the process, the costs and the disclosures before you begin.

sections.note: Religare Broking Limited SEBI broker registration details available upon request.

sections.title: Equity Services Available
items: Demat and trading account opening through Religare Broking Limited
Equity and derivative market trading execution platform access

sections.title: How Account Opening Works
steps: Complete demat KYC documentation with Religare Broking Limited.
Link bank accounts for automated funds transfer (UPI / NetBanking).
Receive trading terminal login credentials, TPIN, and mobile application setup.
Review brokerage rate schedule, exchange statutory charges, and risk management policies.

sections.content: Investments in securities market are subject to market risks. Read all related documents carefully before investing. Lotus Capital does not guarantee returns, price targets, or trading profits.
